# NftyMetadata

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Output` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public record NftyMetadata
```

Rich nfty-specific per-item metadata. Written to `nfty/NNNN.json` alongside the OpenSea file so the OpenSea file stays standards-pure. Carries the generator's extras.

## Constructors

### NftyMetadata(int, string, string, string, IReadOnlyList&lt;RarityAttribute&gt;, IReadOnlyList&lt;LayerColor&gt;, IReadOnlyList&lt;string&gt;?) { #m-ctor-system-int32-system-string-system-string-system-s-934421 }

```csharp
public NftyMetadata(int SetNumber, string Recipe, string Dna, string Seed, IReadOnlyList<RarityAttribute> Rarity, IReadOnlyList<LayerColor> Layers, IReadOnlyList<string>? AbsentLayers = null);
```

**Parameters**

- `SetNumber` (`int`) - The asset's number within the Set.
- `Recipe` (`string`) - The id of the recipe it was rolled from.
- `Dna` (`string`) - Its identity hash.
- `Seed` (`string`) - The seed of the run that produced it.
- `Rarity` (`IReadOnlyList<RarityAttribute>`) - The share of the collection carrying each of its traits.
- `Layers` (`IReadOnlyList<LayerColor>`) - What each layer contributed, including the color it rolled.
- `AbsentLayers` (`IReadOnlyList<string>?`) - The display names of optional layers the roll left out; null when none were.
